title.target: nǎ yìbiān dòng dé gèng duō

pairs.target: dìèrtiān , nánmiàn dàlù dào wǔqián cái chóngxīn fàngxíng . xià róng gēnzhe tóu yìpī chē chūqù , bàngwǎn dàihuí nà zhāng zhēnzhèng jiāo guò jiàn de shōutiáo , lèi dé méi zài tóngtǎ wéi shù shā .
pairs.english: The next day the southern road reopened only before noon. Xiarong left with the first carts and returned at dusk with an actual delivery receipt, too tired to count sand with Tavi again.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天，南面大路到午前才重新放行。夏绒跟着头一批车出去，傍晚带回那张真正交过件的收条，累得没再同塔维数砂。

pairs.target: zhē bù yě yóu mùgōng chóngxīn zhuāng hǎo guàjiàn , tā jiě xià zìjǐ de duǎnshéng , xǐdiào ní , liàng zài chuāng xià , děng tā gāntòu cái shōuhuí dài lǐ .
pairs.english: The carpenter refitted the canopy fastenings too. He untied his short rope, washed off the mud, dried it beneath the window and put it away only when fully dry.
pairs.hanzi: 遮布也由木工重新装好挂件，他解下自己的短绳，洗掉泥，晾在窗下，等它干透才收回袋里。

pairs.target: zhè yìtiān , tāmen réng zhī zuò pǔtōng hé liáng . dào zài xià yírì zǎoshàng , wéi lǎoshī de huíxìn zhōngyú dào le , zhǐ shàng fùzhuó yuán jiājù de biānhào , yě zài tā huà dé hánhu de nàge zhīdiǎn páng tiān le yígè chā .
pairs.english: They still performed only ordinary checks that day. The following morning Instructor Vey's reply finally arrived, bearing the original fixture number and a cross beside the pivot he had drawn unclearly.
pairs.hanzi: 这一天，他们仍只做普通核量。到再下一日早上，维老师的回信终于到了，纸上附着原夹具的编号，也在他画得含糊的那个支点旁添了一个叉。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng kàn wán , xiān jiāng xìnniàn gěi tā tīng , yǔnxǔ de shì zhè fù gǎi guòliàng cè bì de jiēchù liànxí , búshì suǒyǒu huà guò de jiājù dōu néng shì , gèng bù bāokuò zài xīn wèizhì shàng liàn lí shǒu yúliú .
pairs.english: After reading, Ruan Heng read it aloud to him first: permission covered contact practice in this altered measuring-arm fixture, not every drawn fixture, and certainly not hands-off residue at the new position.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡看完，先将信念给他听，允许的是这副改过量测臂的接触练习，不是所有画过的夹具都能试，更不包括在新位置上练离手余留。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng dài chā de tú ná jìn , cái kànqīng lǎoshī gǎi de shì dǎng kuài yǔ zhīdiǎn zhījiān nà yíduàn .
pairs.english: Tavi brought the marked drawing closer and saw the teacher had changed the section between stop and pivot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将带叉的图拿近，才看清老师改的是挡块与支点之间那一段。

pairs.target: ruò zhào zìjǐ zuìzǎo de huàfǎ wǎng lǐ nuó , biǎozhēn dòng dé duō , dǎng kuài què láibùjí jiē zhù guòtóu de wèiyí .
pairs.english: Moved inward as in his earliest drawing, the pointer would travel farther but the stop would fail to catch excessive displacement in time.
pairs.hanzi: 若照自己最早的画法往里挪，表针动得多，挡块却来不及接住过头的位移。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng àn fùhé hòu de tú dìng hǎo mù zuò , yán měiyíchù qīngzǎi hé xiànwèi zài chá yíbiàn , méiyǒu yīnwèi huíxìn lái le , biàn jiāng cǐqián liáng guò de dōu dàngchéng zìdòng hégé .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng set the stand by the reviewed drawing and rechecked every light load and stop, without treating earlier measurements as automatically valid just because the reply had arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡按复核后的图定好木座，沿每一处轻载和限位再查一遍，没有因为回信来了，便将此前量过的都当成自动合格。

pairs.target: tiě jiàn háishì shúxī de nà yíduì , gèzì wánzhěng de tǐjī méiyǒu biàn . liáng cè bì gǎi le láilù , pǔtōng qīngzǎi xià , liǎngbiān yuánshǐ dúshù biàn bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: The iron pieces remained the familiar pair, each whole volume unchanged. With the measuring arm's approach altered, their ordinary light-load baseline readings differed.
pairs.hanzi: 铁件还是熟悉的那一对，各自完整的体积没有变。量测臂改了来路，普通轻载下，两边原始读数便不一样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng nà liǎngháng gèzì chāo qīng , yòu àn ruǎn héng hé guò de huànsuàn zuòchū pángzhù , bùnéng ná liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn zǒuguò yíyàng cháng , dàngchéng jiè dé pínghéng .
pairs.english: Tavi copied both lines separately and added conversions checked by Ruan Heng; equal pointer travel could not be taken as balanced borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将那两行各自抄清，又按阮衡核过的换算作出旁注，不能拿两根指针走过一样长，当成借得平衡。

pairs.target: tā zuòxià shí , xiǎngqǐ yīwén jīnrì yào dào , jīhū xiān qù kàn chuāngwài . ruǎn héng méiyǒu cuī , zhī jiàngmén hé shàng yìdiǎn , dǎngzhù wàimiàn de chē língshēng , wèn tā yào buyào děng wǔhòu .
pairs.english: Sitting, he remembered Iven would arrive today and almost looked outside first. Ruan Heng did not hurry him, only partly closed the door against cart bells and asked if he wanted to wait until afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐下时，想起伊文今日要到，几乎先去看窗外。阮衡没有催，只将门合上一点，挡住外面的车铃声，问他要不要等午后。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , bǎ xìn nuó dào zìjǐ néng kànjiàn yòu búhuì pèng shǒu de wèizhì , xiān jiāng zhùyìlì shōuhuí liǎngpiàn tiě jiàn shàng .
pairs.english: He shook his head, set the letter where he could see it without obstructing his hands, then first returned his attention to the two iron pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头，把信挪到自己能看见又不会碰手的位置，先将注意力收回两片铁件上。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu tiēzhù chù miàn , tā rènqīng de réng shì wánzhěng de cáiliào , búshì ná yì jié liáng cè bì qù tóng lìng yì jié còu yíyàng dà .
pairs.english: With both hands on the contact patches, he attended to the whole material, rather than matching one stretch of measuring arm against another for equal size.
pairs.hanzi: 双手贴住触面，他认清的仍是完整的材料，不是拿一截量测臂去同另一截凑一样大。

pairs.target: qīngzǎi de kèxiàn mànmàn biàndòng , zuǒbiān zǒu dé xiǎnyǎn , yòubiān què zhǐyǒu hěn duǎn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The light-load marks moved slowly, conspicuously on the left but only a very short distance on the right.
pairs.hanzi: 轻载的刻线慢慢变动，左边走得显眼，右边却只有很短一点。

pairs.target: tā xiōngkǒu jǐn le yíxià , chàdiǎn ná shúxī de wàiguān tì tā pàn cuò , yòu kàn le yìyǎn liǎngbiān de huànsuàn xiàn , cái bǎ nà yìxiǎo duàn fǎnxiàng biànhuà rènqīng .
pairs.english: His chest tightened, almost letting the familiar appearance decide it was wrong. Looking again at both conversion scales, he finally recognized the small opposite change.
pairs.hanzi: 他胸口紧了一下，差点拿熟悉的外观替它判错，又看了一眼两边的换算线，才把那一小段反向变化认清。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bàochū yòucè dúshù , méiyǒu tì tā shuō wěn bu wěn . tǎ wéi děng liǎngbiān dōu tíng zài shìxiān huà hǎo de xiǎo fànwéi nèi , cái gàosù tā kěyǐ jì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng called the right reading without deciding its steadiness for him. Tavi waited until both sides stayed within the small premarked range before saying he could record it.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡报出右侧读数，没有替他说稳不稳。塔维等两边都停在事先划好的小范围内，才告诉他可以记。

pairs.target: méiyǒu táishǒu , méi qù jiè shúxī jiátóu nàzhǒng yúliú ; liǎngzhīshǒu shǐzhōng tiēzhe , zhèngcháng shōuhuí zhīhòu , zhǐzhēn xiānhuídào yuánlái de qīngzǎi wèizhì , tā cái sōngkāi .
pairs.english: He did not lift his hands or use that kind of residue from the familiar clamp; both hands stayed touching throughout. After normal cancellation, the pointers first returned to their original light-load positions, and only then did he let go.
pairs.hanzi: 没有抬手，没去借熟悉夹头那种余留；两只手始终贴着，正常收回之后，指针先回到原来的轻载位置，他才松开。

pairs.target: xièzài , guīwèi zài cháwán , zhuōshàng réng shì nà yífù méi duō dà biànhuà de gōngjù .
pairs.english: After unloading and checking return again, the same barely changed tool remained on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 卸载、归位再查完，桌上仍是那一副没多大变化的工具。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎndǐ yǒudiǎn xìxìde suān , zuò zhe huǎn guòlái , méiyǒu zài zuò dìèrcì . tā xiǎng bǎ gāngcái nà yíxià kàn dé gèng qīng , shǒu què méiyǒu gēnzhuó xiǎngfǎ zài wǎng chù miàn shēn .
pairs.english: Tavi's eyes ached faintly. He rested sitting and made no second attempt. He wanted a clearer look at what had just happened, but did not reach for the contact patches again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维眼底有点细细的酸，坐着缓过来，没有再做第二次。他想把刚才那一下看得更清，手却没有跟着想法再往触面伸。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng jìlù fàngdào pángbiān , jiào tā xiān hēshuǐ . tǎ wéi pěng zhe wǎn , wèn zhèzhǒng kànqǐlái chà hěnduō , qíshí hái zài xiǎo fànwéi lǐ de shì , yǐhòu shìbushì huì dàochù pèngjiàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng set the record aside and told him to drink first. Holding the bowl, Tavi asked whether he would often meet things that looked very different while still within a small range.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将记录放到旁边，叫他先喝水。塔维捧着碗，问这种看起来差很多、其实还在小范围里的事，以后是不是会到处碰见。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō huì , zìjǐ rújīn kàn biérén de xiè jià , yě dé xiān wèn nǎ chù yuánlái jiù huì dòng , bùnéng kànjiàn yígè rén táishǒu , biàn jiāng hòumiàn suǒyǒu shì dōu suàn zài nà zhī shǒushàng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said yes: even now, inspecting another person's rack, he first had to ask what moved originally, rather than attributing everything afterward to someone's raised hand.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说会，自己如今看别人的卸架，也得先问哪处原来就会动，不能看见一个人抬手，便将后面所有事都算在那只手上。

pairs.target: " nín dāngnián zuì xiǎng zuò shénme ? " tǎ wéi wèn . ruǎn héng yǐwéi tā wèn xué gōnglǐ de liànxí , xiǎng le yíhuìer , shuō tì jùchǎng zuò yíduàn néng zhuǎnxiàng de mù guǐ .
pairs.english: “What did you most want to do back then?” Tavi asked. Ruan Heng thought he meant academy exercises, paused, then said he had wanted to build a turning curtain rail for a theater.
pairs.hanzi:
“您当年最想做什么？”塔维问。
阮衡以为他问学宫里的练习，想了一会儿，说替剧场做一段能转向的幕轨。

pairs.target: tāmen xiānqián kànguò yìchǎng xì , huànjǐng shí yǒurén bèi bùlián chánzhù , lián hǎn sānshēng mén méi kāi , guānzhòng hái dàngzuò táicí , xiào dé bǐ zhèng xì xiǎng .
pairs.english: They had seen a play where someone got caught in a curtain during a scene change and shouted three times that the door would not open. The audience took it as dialogue and laughed louder than at the play.
pairs.hanzi: 他们先前看过一场戏，换景时有人被布帘缠住，连喊三声门没开，观众还当作台词，笑得比正戏响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn hòulái zuò le méiyǒu . tā shuō zuò le , yòng guò liǎng wǎn , dìsān wǎn yǒurén zài táishàng cǎi pòbù , shuō háishì zuò mù guǐ de fàng dé tài dī .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if he had built it. He had: it lasted two nights, then on the third someone tore the cloth underfoot on stage and blamed the rail builder for hanging it too low.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问后来做了没有。他说做了，用过两晚，第三晚有人在台上踩破布，说还是做幕轨的放得太低。

pairs.target: zìjǐ nàshí qì dé qù tóng rén zhēng , hòulái cái fāxiàn liánzǐ ràng biérén huàn cháng le , bìng búshì měigè huàichù dōu yánzhe yígè rén de shǒu liúxiàlái .
pairs.english: He had angrily argued then, only later finding that someone else had fitted a longer curtain. Not every flaw came from a single person's hand.
pairs.hanzi: 自己那时气得去同人争，后来才发现帘子让别人换长了，并不是每个坏处都沿着一个人的手留下来。

pairs.target: tā shuō dào zhèlǐ yòu xiào , chéngrèn zìjǐ dāngwǎn bùkěn xiān tīng , mà dé yě nántīng , suǒyǐ guò le xǔduōnián , hái jìde nàtiáo duō chūlái de bù biān .
pairs.english: He laughed again, admitting he had refused to listen that night and sworn badly too, which was why he remembered the extra cloth edge years later.
pairs.hanzi: 他说到这里又笑，承认自己当晚不肯先听，骂得也难听，所以过了许多年，还记得那条多出来的布边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn shǒulǐ de shuǐ , méiyǒu jiāng zhèhuà chāo chéng yígè gāi bèi de jiélùn , zhī wèn nàchǎng xì hòulái yǒuméiyǒu chóngyǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at his water without copying it as a conclusion to memorize, only asking if the play had ever been staged again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看手里的水，没有将这话抄成一个该背的结论，只问那场戏后来有没有重演。

alignment.english: if the play had ever been

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō bù zhīdào , jùchǎng huàn le zhǎng shì , zìjǐ yě huàn le dìfāng . ruò xiàhuí zhēn pèngjiàn , xiǎng xiān kànkàn nà shànmén rújīn kāi dé kāi bu kāi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng did not know: the theater had changed managers and he had moved too. If he found it again, he wanted first to see whether that door opened now.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说不知道，剧场换了掌事，自己也换了地方。若下回真碰见，想先看看那扇门如今开得开不开。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhuōbiān gěi nǚér xuǎn de bù yàng shōu jìn bāo , dòngzuò bǐ shuō jùchǎng shí qīng yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He put the cloth samples chosen for his daughter into his bag, more gently than when speaking of the theater.
pairs.hanzi: 他将桌边给女儿选的布样收进包，动作比说剧场时轻一点。

pairs.target: shōu hǎo gōngjù hòu , tǎ wéi cái bǎ nài lěi nà fēngxìn ná chūlái , jiǎng tā wèn suíxíng huì jì de shì , yě jiǎng zìjǐ xiǎng qù , bù zhǐshì zài děng tā zài jiào yìhuí .
pairs.english: After putting away the tools, Tavi brought out Nerai's letter and explained her accompanying-sketch invitation, saying he wanted to go rather than merely wait for her to ask again.
pairs.hanzi: 收好工具后，塔维才把奈蕾那封信拿出来，讲她问随行绘记的事，也讲自己想去，不只是在等她再叫一回。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng cóngtóu kàn wán , xiān wèn túhuà quán le méiyǒu , jiào tā huà quán biàn nálái yìqǐ kàn , chāishì , shírì hé xuégōng de ānpái dōu néng tán , què bùnéng xiànzài biàn dàngchéng yǐjīng dìngxià .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng read it fully, first asked whether the map was complete, then told him to bring it when finished. The job, dates and academy arrangements could be discussed, but were not settled already.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡从头看完，先问图画全了没有，叫他画全便拿来一起看，差事、时日和学宫的安排都能谈，却不能现在便当成已经定下。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yíliàng gōnglù chē mànmàn jìn le yuànzi , tǎ wéi zhàn qǐlái , yòu xiān jiāng zìjǐ de dúshù zhǐjiá jìn gānjìng de bǎn lǐ . nà fù jiājù hái liúzài zhuōshàng , zuò guò de yícì yě liúzài zhǐ shàng , tā zhè cái tuī mén chūqù kàn chēshàng xiàlái de shì shuí .
pairs.english: Outside, a road cart slowly entered the yard. Tavi stood, first tucking his readings into a clean board. The fixture stayed on the table and the one completed trial on paper; only then did he go out to see who was getting off.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外一辆公路车慢慢进了院子，塔维站起来，又先将自己的读数纸夹进干净的板里。那副夹具还留在桌上，做过的一次也留在纸上，他这才推门出去看车上下来的是谁。
